supportingSources.label: Kineticist Spectrum machine guide and playfield

strategy.overview: Break a secret four-color code. Press the right flipper to serve the ball, then guess each position by hitting two targets in one colored bank. A clue saucer rules out its lit color or flashes when that color is correct; collect a flashing clue at the same saucer or matching bank. Correct positions carry into the next attempt. Break all four for a Star, complete the four bonus rollovers for Bonus X, and complete all four Spectral Curve lights to add a ball.
strategy.simpleOverview: Press the right flipper to serve the ball. Guess each code position by hitting two targets in one color bank. A clue saucer rules out its lit color or flashes when that color is correct; collect a flashing clue at the same saucer or the matching bank. Solve all four positions for a Star, and complete all four Spectral Curve lights to add a ball.
strategy.summary: Use clue saucers to remove bad colors before committing to angled banks. Preserve confirmed positions across attempts, and take the Spectral Curve whenever a controlled shot can build toward another ball.

quickInfo.name: Make a Guess
quickInfo.summary: Hit two targets in one color bank.

quickInfo.name: Get a Clue
quickInfo.summary: Shoot a saucer under its lit color arrow.

quickInfo.name: Add a Ball
quickInfo.summary: Complete all four Spectral Curve lights.

steps.text: Press the right flipper button to eject the ball from the center drain saucer.
Shoot a clue saucer to test its lit color; an unlit result removes that color for the current position, while a flashing arrow confirms it.
Enter a color guess by knocking down two of the three targets in that color bank, or collect a flashing correct clue at the same saucer.
Solve all four code positions for a Star, and use full Spectral Curve shots to light all four curve lamps for an added ball.

alternatives.title: Fast guessing route
alternatives.when: Use this when a bank is safely available but the clue saucers are feeding dangerously.

steps.text: Guess directly by hitting two targets in the chosen color bank.
Use incorrect guesses as exclusions on the next attempt while preserving any correct positions.
Solve all four positions in the secret code for one Star.
Break five codes total to exchange four Stars for a Super Star.

machineSetup: Check ROM revision, Add-A-Ball behavior, clue and rollover carryover, in-order rollover requirements, Special awards, and the large center-drain setup.
Test all four three-target color banks, three clue saucers and arrows, both spinners, hidden side-lane switches and reservoir kickouts, Spectral Curve switches, bonus rollovers, and ball serve.

techniques.name: Live Catch
techniques.instruction: The hidden lanes fire a reservoir ball down an inlane; catch it immediately instead of flipping on reaction toward the wide center drain.

cautions.issue: ROM revision 0 and earlier reportedly do not award Add-A-Balls from the Spectral Curve.
cautions.response: Confirm the installed revision before devoting a ball to all four curve lights.
